verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a hosted AI app-builder like Figma Make, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics opt-outs, or data-use controls. The items on securely stored keys and backends cover a different capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
